content.rationale: The store and the schema are separate commitments: the store fixes what an entry means and how it is written, the schema fixes the document shape every reader checks before decoding. A closed object and a hex-or-null value keep a corrupt entry from decoding into a plausible one. The absolute `$id` is required because the validator compiles a schema only under an absolute identifier, and embedding it keeps checked-in shapes checked by the binary that reads them.
